content.title: Estée Lauder (EL): Losses Have Worsened 47.6% Annually, Challenging Market Optimism on Turnaround
content.summary: Estée Lauder Companies (EL) continues to struggle with profitability, reporting losses that have deepened at a rate of 47.6% per year over the past five years. Profit margins remain under pressure as well. Despite these challenges, analysts forecast earnings to grow at a robust 47.57% per year, with a return to profitability expected within the next three years.
